Trump on Iran:

Iran wants to make a deal so badly. They are calling constantly.

I am not going to make a deal that’s no good. We gotta make the right deal. https://t.co/lnQDrcDnB3

Trump:

Iran will end right after, maybe before, the midterms. Gasoline is gonna drop like a rock. https://t.co/ON0VdeZLrC

Reporter: Do you expect Congress would need to approve the $5,000 dividend?

Trump: It’s $5,000 to all adults in the country, and we can easily handle that because we’re taking in so much money. https://t.co/rebrxMxKWi
